assumptions: Canvas FPS comes from monotonic same-generation cumulative submitted counts; startup and post-1s/post-2s windows are separate.
Video FPS is presented-frame advancement in full telemetry publication intervals.
Raw media averages sum complete RTC delta intervals inside each committed generation.
Paired frame deficits use matching cached sample IDs and cumulative RTC counters.
Full three-second minima require matching renderer identity and >=2999ms coverage.
Browser physical scanout and unavailable GPU timing remain capability-limited.
